concept_en: The Sequence of a Pawn-Side Attack
question_cn: 国王印度防御中黑方e5之后走f5-f4翼兵进攻。为什么f5必须在特定时机走，而不是立刻跟进？
question_en: In the King's Indian, why should Black prepare ...f5 before launching the ...f5-f4 pawn attack after ...e5?

options.text_cn: f5越快越好，早一步推进早一步获得空间
options.text_en: Play ...f5 as soon as possible to gain space earlier.

options.text_cn: f5推进前需要确认e5兵已稳固、g5无法被白方利用、且王翼子力（Nf6/Ng6）已配置好协同推进
options.text_en: Make sure the e5-pawn is secure, White cannot use g5, and Black's kingside pieces are ready to support the advance.

options.text_cn: f5只有在白方走了f3后才有意义
options.text_en: ...f5 matters only after White has played f3.

options.text_cn: f5的时机与其他棋子无关，随时可以走
options.text_en: The timing of ...f5 is unrelated to the other pieces, so it can be played at any time.

explanation_cn: 翼兵进攻的节奏链：每步推进都依赖前一步的准备。f5前必须确认：①e5稳固（不会被白方dxe5后e4兵暴露）；②f5推进后g5格不被白方马（Ng5）利用；③己方Nf6/Rook已配置到位支撑f5-f4的后续推进。国王印度f5-f4是典型的「节奏链」——每步棋都为下一步铺路，若某步时机错误整条链都会断裂。正确节奏：e5锁定中心→Nd7重组→f5空间扩展→f4锁死白方→g5总攻。
explanation_en: A wing attack is a sequence in which each pawn advance depends on prior preparation. Before ...f5, Black should secure the e5-pawn, ensure White cannot exploit g5, and place the kingside pieces to support ...f4. In the King's Indian, the plan ...e5, ...Nd7, ...f5, and ...f4 builds step by step; mistiming one move can break the entire sequence.
